description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to improve the access to affordable healthcare products to consumers in Ecuador provinces, including in more rural areas. The Project is expected to create new jobs and has the potential to promote economic linkages to the rest of the economy. Increased investments in a new distribution center will have direct, indirect and induced multiplier effects on the economy by adding value across supply chains. At the market level, the Project will contribute to the regional healthcare system resilience by supporting the Company to expand and increase its capacity to respond to future health crises.

The proposed investment consists of an IFC A Loan of up to US$20 million to Farmaenlace (the Company), a leading pharmaceutical retailer and distributor based in Ecuador. The proposed IFC Loan will finance the development of a new distribution center in Llano Grande following green building practices (seeking EDGE certification), the expansion of the Companys pharmacy network across the country and the refinancing of the Companys short-term lines (The Project).
